data.title: bn-3vk: M0.1.5 Test whether a rule, intercept or hook can touch requests send, and what a session adds to a send

data.reason: LGTM at bf6c133. Lead review reran the pinned-binary loopback harness and full checks. Positive proxy controls prove the replace rule and independent Lua request/response hooks were live while requests send bypassed them; active intercept state is explicitly qualified without a positive proxy control. Expired POST sent once plus one login GET, while GET retried once and then paused. INV-49 remains required.
